title_en: On Sunday a Young Lad Came
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Не ме кани ... при теб' да седам' is my reading: 'do not invite me to stay with you' (the lad is speaking, probably the girl being told not to ask). Speaker roles in the middle stanzas are my interpretation.

words_to_learn.en: young lad (fixed folk phrase, 'young and wild')

lines.cyr: В' недела дојде лудо младо
lines.lat: V' nedela dojde ludo mlado
lines.en: On Sunday a young lad came

lines.cyr: у нас на гости.
lines.lat: u nas na gosti.
lines.en: to us as a guest.

lines.cyr: Седе два дни, седе три дни
lines.lat: Sede dva dni, sede tri dni
lines.en: He stayed two days, he stayed three days,

lines.cyr: седеше недела.
lines.lat: sedeše nedela.
lines.en: he stayed a week.

lines.cyr: Па си тргна да си оди
lines.lat: Pa si trgna da si odi
lines.en: Then he set off to go

lines.cyr: в' туѓа туѓина.
lines.lat: v' tuǵa tuǵina.
lines.en: to a foreign land.

lines.cyr: Лудо младо не оди в' туѓина,
lines.lat: Ludo mlado ne odi v' tuǵina,
lines.en: Young lad, do not go to a foreign land,

lines.cyr: лудо младо, остани лудо младо при мене.
lines.lat: ludo mlado, ostani ludo mlado pri mene.
lines.en: young lad, stay with me, young lad.

lines.cyr: Не ме кани лудо младо
lines.lat: Ne me kani ludo mlado
lines.en: Do not invite me, young lad,

lines.cyr: при теб' да седам,
lines.lat: pri teb' da sedam,
lines.en: to stay with you,

lines.cyr: мене чека стара мајка
lines.lat: mene čeka stara majka
lines.en: my old mother is waiting for me

lines.cyr: и стари татко.
lines.lat: i stari tatko.
lines.en: and my old father.

lines.cyr: Лудо младо земи ме со тебе,
lines.lat: Ludo mlado zemi me so tebe,
lines.en: Young lad, take me with you,

lines.cyr: лудо младо, не можам лудо младо без тебе.
lines.lat: ludo mlado, ne možam ludo mlado bez tebe.
lines.en: young lad, I cannot, young lad, without you.

lines.cyr: Јас не можам да те земам
lines.lat: Jas ne možam da te zemam
lines.en: I cannot take you

lines.cyr: тебе со мене,
lines.lat: tebe so mene,
lines.en: with me,

lines.cyr: јас си имам друго либе
lines.lat: jas si imam drugo libe
lines.en: I have another sweetheart

lines.cyr: и машко дете.
lines.lat: i maško dete.
lines.en: and a baby boy.

lines.cyr: Младој моме не оди по мене,
lines.lat: Mladoj mome ne odi po mene,
lines.en: Young maiden, do not follow me,

lines.cyr: малој моме, не жали мило моме за мене.
lines.lat: maloj mome, ne žali milo mome za mene.
lines.en: little maiden, do not grieve for me, dear maiden.

lines.cyr: Лудо младо, земи ме со тебе,
lines.lat: Ludo mlado, zemi me so tebe,
lines.en: Young lad, take me with you,

lines.cyr: лудо младо, не можам лудо младо без тебе.
lines.lat: ludo mlado, ne možam ludo mlado bez tebe.
lines.en: young lad, I cannot, young lad, without you.
